liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Same Thing** (3 reviews): This version of the song was released on the So Many Roads box set; The jam is called an excellent example of early Garcia playing [8][9][11]
- **Golden Road to Unlimited Devotion** (1 review): Reviewer says this is the only live recording of the song they could find [15]

## Setlist highlights

- **Golden Road to Unlimited Devotion**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [17]
- **Cream Puff War**: rare: 12 archived performances [17]

## The recordings

- **gd67-03-18.sbd.fink.10282.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 14 songs; 87 min; rated 4.54/5 by 57 [1]. Said about its sound: Garcia's Guild hollowbody gives a clear, articulate guitar sound, similar to his later Stratocaster tone; Quality ranges from passable to rough, with volume dropouts and distortion amid decent mid-60s clarity; Reviewer finds the sound quite good compared with other recordings from the period [6][8][9][10][11][13][14]
- **gd1967-03-18.141400.sbd.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1648**: soundboard; 14 songs; 87 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1967-03-18.sbd.sacks.1594.shnf**: soundboard; 14 songs; 86 min; rated 4.67/5 by 6 [3]
- **gd1967-03-18.156086.sbd.Flegel.flac1648**: soundboard; 14 songs; 88 min; rated 4/5 by 7 [4]

## Around the show

- Pigpen played Hammond B3 organ and harmonica [4]
- Johnny Talbot & De Thangs performed on He Was a Friend of Mine and Beat It On Down the Line [4]
- The band changes greatly by year's end, when Garcia plays a Gibson Les Paul with thicker tone [6]
- Several later concert staples, including Me and My Uncle, Dancin' and Morning Dew, appear here in early form [8]
- The song was reportedly played only three times in thirty years [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd67-03-18.sbd.fink.10282.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by A.J. Fink; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: A short gap near 13:34 to 13:37 in The Same Thing and Viola Lee Blues was patched from a higher generation source by A.J. Fink [1]
- **gd1967-03-18.141400.sbd.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Tim Dalton; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Master Soundboard Reels > Cassette > Reel to Reel > Dat (16-bit/48k); Transfer Info: Dat (16/48)(Sony PCM-R500) > Tascam DA-3000… [2]
- **gd1967-03-18.sbd.sacks.1594.shnf**: transferred by Darrin Sacks; source: MSR>R>DATs>CDRs>EAC>SHN [3]
- **gd1967-03-18.156086.sbd.Flegel.flac1648**: taped by This came from an anonymous source via CD.; transferred by All post work done by Brian Flegel; source: Master Soundboard Reels > ?? > CD > .wav > flac [4]
